description: Stammformen Trainer: a Latin principal-parts trainer. Flashcards (flip, swipe, keyboard), a typed self-test that is forgiving about accents, commas and spacing but strict about the forms, and a searchable list, over a vocabulary list you import yourself (the spin ships empty -- bring a backup file of this spin or a verb page you already have). Chapter groups come from the lessons in your list, with per-lesson switches, core-verb and conjugation filters, a mastered counter, your own groups, bulk paste and a photo/PDF scan that reads a printed word list through the AI spin with your own Gemini key (needs ai-test 0.1.2 or newer; the page never holds a key). Your list, progress and test history are stored in Sotrice's data folder, outside the spin, so updating or reinstalling it never touches them; export and import as JSON.
author: prackoreal
